# Legacy Investing Show

> Tax strategy, wealth-building systems, and decision tools from Preston Seo for professionals, investors, and founders who want to keep more, grow faster, and build lasting wealth.

## Business Focus

Legacy Investing Show is a tax-and-wealth-first education brand.

Primary focus areas:
- Tax strategy and planning
- Wealth-building systems
- Retirement optimization
- Business structure and asset protection
- Investing and cash-flow decisions

Secondary focus area:
- Airbnb arbitrage and alternative income

## Who It Helps

- High-income earners
- Business owners and consultants
- Real estate investors
- Professionals building their first real wealth system
- People who make good money but feel like taxes, debt, and complexity are slowing them down

## Proof

- $15M+ personal real estate portfolio built by Preston
- 2,000+ students guided
- 6.5M+ combined social reach
- 30+ documented case studies and student stories

## Most Valuable Content

- [Tax Strategies](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tax-strategies/): primary hub for tax planning, deductions, entities, and real-estate tax moves
- [Compare Guides](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/compare/): decision pages for edge-case money choices
- [Free Tools](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/): 70+ free personal-finance calculators for budgets, loans, mortgages, tax estimates, and insurance
- [Personal Money Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/money): budgets, savings goals, debt payoff, and net worth
- [Banking & Borrowing Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/banking-borrowing): loans, APY, amortization, and credit costs
- [Taxes & Payroll Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/taxes-payroll): take-home pay, withholding, and tax reserves
- [Housing & Moving Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/housing-moving): rent, mortgages, equity, and move-in costs
- [Insurance Calculators](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/tools/categories/insurance-protection): renters, auto, pet, health, and income protection
- [Worksheets](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/worksheets/): printable and fillable planning worksheets
- [Blog](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/blog/): strategy articles, case studies, and transcript-based resource posts
- [Success Stories](https://www.legacyinvestingshow.com/success-stories): curated student results and execution stories

## Core Programs

- [Free Tax Strategy Masterclass](https://www.managemoney101.com/2025workshop): tax-focused training for high earners, business owners, and investors

## Positioning Notes

- Airbnb arbitrage is part of the library, not the whole company.
- The site emphasizes practical execution, not generic inspiration.
- Decision pages, tools, and worksheets are core assets.
